title: Stability and Dynamics of the N‑Terminal Domain of TDP-43 and the Effect of Point Mutations.
authors: Pinar, Oguzhan; Jana, Asis K; Yasar, Fatih
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子MD模拟研究TDP-43 N端结构域及其点突变体的构象稳定性，虽涉及DNA结合蛋白但未聚焦TF-DNA互作或结合机制，方法为物理模拟但对象与互作轴偏离课题核心。
abstract: TAR DNA-binding protein (TDP-43) has been identified as a major pathological protein in several neurodegenerative diseases. The stable, folded structure of its N-terminal domain (NTD) is thought to be requisite for its physiological function, with any structural disruption potentially leading to aberrant aggregation. In the present study, we have employed long, unbiased all-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to study the conformational stability of the NTD monomer and two of its mutants (L27A and L28A). Since the choice of force field can significantly impact simulation outcomes, we used two different force fields (CHARMM36m and CHARMM36mW). In agreement with experimental data, our simulations using both force fields conclusively demonstrate that the wild-type NTD and the L27A mutant remain structurally stable, while the L28A mutation significantly disrupts tertiary contacts, exposing buried hydrophobic residues and thereby destabilizing the folded structure. Furthermore, across all systems, CHARMM36m simulations exhibited greater overall stability than CHARMM36mW, consistent with our previous study on Abeta fibrils. Importantly, our simulations provide mechanistic insights at the atomic level with significant implications for understanding the NTD's role in both normal cellular function and pathological aggregation.
abstract_zh: TAR DNA结合蛋白（TDP-43）已被确定为多种神经退行性疾病中的主要病理蛋白。其N端结构域（NTD）的稳定折叠结构被认为对其生理功能至关重要，任何结构破坏都可能导致异常聚集。在本研究中，我们采用长时间、无偏的全原子分子动力学（MD）模拟来研究NTD单体及其两个突变体（L27A和L28A）的构象稳定性。由于力场的选择可能显著影响模拟结果，我们使用了两种不同的力场（CHARMM36m和CHARMM36mW）。与实验数据一致，我们使用两种力场的模拟均明确表明，野生型NTD和L27A突变体在结构上保持稳定，而L28A突变显著破坏三级接触，暴露埋藏的疏水残基，从而破坏折叠结构的稳定性。此外，在所有系统中，CHARMM36m模拟表现出比CHARMM36mW更高的整体稳定性，这与我们先前对Aβ纤维的研究一致。重要的是，我们的模拟在原子水平上提供了机制性见解，对理解NTD在正常细胞功能和病理聚集中的作用具有重要意义。
